min_live_voice_note: Phase 2.8.1: the creator live voice measured on the mic stem ONLY must cover >= 30% of runtime (hard floor; policy may only raise it). TTS/voiceover can top the total up to 60% but cannot replace the creator.
owner_twitch_login_note: Default owner (twitch.tv/cutscenecity; public login, not a secret). CUTSCENECITY_OWNER_TWITCH_LOGIN overrides it; if both are empty every VOD is rejected (fail closed).

voice_presets.name: charon-relaxed
voice_presets.style: relaxed, conversational, light Indian English accent

cutscenecity-default.description: Placeholder: set after Shebin's OBS layout is known

facecam-right-chat-left.description: Example: facecam top-right, chat overlay on the left edge

daily_upload_cap_note: Hard maximum 1 in code (Python and Node), back from 2 in phase 2.7 (Compliance): min(env CUTSCENECITY_DAILY_CAP or policy, 1); 0/negative/invalid blocks. Counted per IST (UTC+05:30) calendar day.

overlay_scan.effect: flags only; overlays_third_parties_cleared always needs a signed human sign-off, with a 5+ word note when flagged or unavailable

caption_policy.source_note: Captions are transcribed ONLY from a separate creator mic stem (OBS multitrack --mic-stream N or a --mic file). Mixed Twitch VOD tracks and game tracks are refused (they caption plot dialogue and other voices).
caption_policy.profanity_match: case-insensitive prefix of each caption word (fuck -> fucking, fucked); masked as first letter + * (f******)
caption_policy.audio_bleep_note: Phase 2.8: the creator mic stem transcript is scanned for profanity_terms (render.profanity_audio, word timestamps in ms). The per-clip human edit choice can bleep them: review.py edit --bleep tone (1 kHz tone) | mute | off (default off). Strong profanity in the first profanity_warn_first_seconds blocks the clip unless bleeped. profanity_audio_reviewed (human) is pinned to the final file SHA-256. Captions are still masked as before.
caption_policy.keyword_list_status: PLACEHOLDER: Shebin/Compliance must replace the PLACEHOLDER_* entries with real story character names and plot keywords. Entries starting with PLACEHOLDER are ignored by the scan, and while any remain every caption review is flagged.
caption_policy.plot_keywords_note: spoiler-defaults.json terms and spoiler-keywords.txt are scanned too (shared with the metadata spoiler gate).
caption_policy.title_thumbnail_check: Phase 2.8: metadata.title and metadata.thumbnail_text are checked against profanity_terms (auto gate title_thumbnail_profanity_free; Node re-checks).

edit_policy.choice: Per clip, by a named human: review.py edit --clip F --style clean|hype --effects a,b --by NAME (signed edit_choice). Renders refuse edit effects without it.
edit_policy.flash_cut: off by default; at most 1 per clip; intensity <= 0.5 (hard limits in edit.py and the Node gate)
edit_policy.default_note: Default per-clip choice is clean (captions only, mic stem required). hype is opt-in: review.py edit --style hype --effects ... --by NAME. Nothing is edited until a human records the choice (fix 7).

game_audio_note: Phase 2.8 (Shebin override, 9:24 AM): game audio is KEPT by default. Upload renders are audio_mode mix = original game audio (music volume default 1.0) + the separate creator mic stem at gain 1.0 + optional voiceover/TTS on top; no ducking. Stripping game audio is the opt-in review.py commentary --strip-game-audio (audio_mode mic_stem). --keep-game-audio is accepted as a no-op. The mic stem is still required for the 60% commentary measurement and captions. Kept game audio may contain licensed radio/score: music_risk_cleared needs a whole-clip listen + note.
mixed_track_note: Phase 2.8 (Compliance): the mixed-track bypass was REMOVED. A clip without a separate creator mic stem always fails original_commentary / live_reaction_preserved: commentary must be measured (60% of runtime) on the mic stem. The old opt-ins (env CUTSCENECITY_ALLOW_MIXED_TRACK, policy mixed_track_path_enabled) are ignored.
